description: This PHP file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeAnniversaryAPI within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes test methods for the 'getAll' API endpoint and checks for not implemented methods like create, delete, and their validation rules. The class extends a custom endpoint integration test case and uses data providers and mock services to perform its tests.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversaryAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeAnniversaryAPI endpoint, testing retrieval of all anniversary records and handling of not implemented methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API method with different test cases provided by a data provider, setting up fixture data and mocking necessary services.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAll' method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'create' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving validation rules for create throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'delete' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving validation rules for delete throws a 'not implemented' exception.
